text:
Situation: Cefazolin sodium is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. An earlier shortage was first posted 2018-11-30 and is resolved. Corvale East holds 128 units of the 2 g/50 mL presentation at 14.4 per day (8.9 days on hand). Corvale General holds 279 units at 16.1 per day (17.3 days on hand). Other presentations and sites have adequate stock.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show cefazolin sodium is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; an earlier shortage was first posted 2018-11-30 and is resolved. FDA inspected the Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. plant (FEI 3002807173) multiple times, including an OAI classification on 2014-03-28 and a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21, with the most recent VAI on 2023-04-21. The 2018-11-30 shortage posting came 962 days after a VAI inspection ended 2016-04-12 at that plant. A later VAI inspection ended 2020-03-06, 462 days after the 2018-11-30 posting.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The immediate risk is localized low days-on-hand at Corvale East for the 2 g/50 mL presentation. Internal redistribution can resolve this without external purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 53 units of cefazolin sodium 2 g/50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Monitor daily usage at both sites and adjust par levels — approved by pharmacy operations manager.
3. If transfer is delayed, evaluate purchase from Samson Medical Technologies, L.L.C., Sandoz Inc, WG Critical Care, LLC, or Apotex Corp. — approved by buyer and pharmacy director.

Not recommended: Emergency purchases from alternative suppliers while internal stock is available and no national shortage exists.
